title: Whimsical Fantasy Collage
description: A vibrant surreal painting split into colorful sections featuring a large blue and orange cat in the upper left, a green elephant floating above, a witch flying on a broomstick inside a glowing yellow portal, and a friendly green dragon in the bottom right. The background contains hot air balloons, colorful spheres, and abstract geometric patterns.
